title: bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2: Frobenius-orbit parallel rho in GT (v2)

claims.statement: For a uniform nonidentity P in BLS12-381 G1 and an independent uniform z in GT, the attack in proof.md returns Q=[a]Q0 in G2 with e(P,Q)=z under the pinned pairing convention, using at most 2^126.32 total target-group-operation equivalents (dense Fp12 multiplications, C=20,000). It computes g=e(P,Q0) and solves z=g^a by parallel distinguished-point Pollard rho on orbits of the order-12 Frobenius automorphism of GT. A twisted-state 2^20-adding walk uses pre-twisted table entries, so each step is one dense Fp12 multiplication plus 8 Fp multiplications for the 12 one-coordinate class keys; 1.25 units per step are charged. Walks restart at every distinguished point via a cheap rule (new start = previous distinguished point times a random table entry, one multiplication), so the ~2^106.3 restarts cost ~2^106.6 units, below 2^-19 of the main term and fully charged. Under the stated random-mapping heuristic, supported by toy experiments that count every multiplication (including look-ahead retries and restarts), the success probability is at least 0.39. The budget is 1.25*sqrt(2*N*ln(1/0.61)) useful steps on N=(r-1)/12+1 classes, times 1.03 for abandoned fruitless-cycle walks; look-ahead removes the dominant 2-cycles and the residual waste is bounded for any 4-cycle constant C4<=2^10 at R=2^20. Additive setup, restart, distinguished-point storage, detection-lag and output costs total ~2^-19.4 of the main term. Peak memory is at most 2^113 bytes; preprocessing is at most 2^32 units and is included; nonuniform advice is 0 bytes. This is a classical cold attack with no uncharged advice or quantum steps; generic accounting of known techniques, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Twisted-state parallel distinguished-point rho on orbits of an order-12 automorphism x->x^lam in a prime-order-l subgroup of F_q^*, with look-ahead, cheap D*M_j restarts, and abandon-and-restart. Counts EVERY multiplication (steps, look-ahead retries, restarts). Reports mean multiplications relative to sqrt(pi*N/2), success within the 1.25*k0 budget, the wasted-step fraction, and the fruitless-cycle entry rate (with a lookahead toggle to show look-ahead removing cycles). Toy-scale evidence for the random-mapping heuristic, the sqrt(12) class speedup, cheap-restart efficiency, and fruitless-cycle suppression only.
